title: Montreux Jazz Festival welcomes 250,000 fans to 60th edition
summary: Montreux Jazz Festival has wrapped up its 60th anniversary edition on 18 July after welcoming over 250,000 fans to its 16 days of music. title: New Australian pension laws blamed for festival cancellations
summary: New payday laws in Australia have led to the cancellation of multiple events, as the country’s live sector says they have placed extra financial burdens on those paying artist fees. Laws in place since the beginning of July, known as the Superannuation Guarantee, require those paying artists for performances to make pension contributions within seven days of the artist receiving their fee.
